signals.label: Lifetime definition
signals.finding: The vendor may discontinue the product, which ends a lifetime deal.

evidence.quote: PearlMountain Limited reserves a right to add, modify, impose conditions, suspend, discontinue, or permanently remove any feature or aspect of the Service at its sole discretion and without any obligations, whatsoever.

signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage. 5 reviews say limits were reduced.

evidence.quote: Please note that FlexClip will archive resources uploaded to the server that are not used after 180 days.

finePrint.summary: Buyer’s access to features can be changed or removed at any time at the vendor’s sole discretion.

quote.text: PearlMountain Limited reserves a right to add, modify, impose conditions, suspend, discontinue, or permanently remove any feature or aspect of the Service at its sole discretion and without any obligations, whatsoever.

finePrint.summary: Subscription prices and promotions can be changed at any time without protection for deal buyers.

quote.text: All prices, promotions, and special offers on the Site and Services shall be subject to change at any time.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can refuse, restrict, suspend or terminate accounts at any time without obligation.

quote.text: We reserve a right to refuse, restrict, suspend, or terminate your account at any time and without any obligations, whatsoever.

finePrint.summary: No refund or compensation is allowed if a paid subscription is restricted, suspended or terminated without notice.

quote.text: No claims, refund, or compensation shall be admissible on the grounds that your subscription to FlexClip paid plans was restricted, suspended, or terminated without any prior notice.

finePrint.summary: Paid plans have only a 7-day money-back window for lifetime-deal buyers to evaluate.

quote.text: Therefore, we provide a 7-day money back policy.

finePrint.summary: The 7-day refund applies only to the first order in a subscription period.

quote.text: Please note, this policy only applies to the first order made during the subscription period.

finePrint.summary: Credit packages are non-refundable once purchased, limiting refund protection for credit-based use.

quote.text: However, this policy does not apply to credit packages, which are non-refundable once purchased, except where required by law.

finePrint.summary: Unused uploads and projects are archived after 180 days and require activation to reuse.

finePrint.summary: Cloud files can be disabled for high usage or suspected misuse, limiting unlimited storage expectations.

quote.text: We reserve the right to disable any file stored on our cloud storage that we believe are misusing it.

finePrint.summary: Support staff cannot make binding promises beyond the written agreement, limiting reliance on support assurances.

quote.text: However, the support staff and other representatives are not authorized to make any claims or representations which have been specifically mentioned in this Agreement.

trials.claim: All future Plus and Business plan updates are included
trials.claimQuote: All future Plus plan (Tier 1) or Business plan (Tiers 2&3) updates
trials.reasoning: The terms disclaim any guarantee that features will be available in the future, and a buyer reports updates were not always provided as claimed.

exhibits.quote: We do not guarantee that any templates, editing tools, graphics, or other features will be available in the future.
exhibits.argument: The vendor disclaims any guarantee that features will remain available, undermining a promise of all future updates.

exhibits.quote: They claim to provide updates, but that’s not always true.
exhibits.argument: A Tier 3 buyer reports updates were not provided, directly contradicting the all-future-updates promise.

trials.claim: Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into new features and limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into any new features and feature limits
trials.reasoning: Two buyers report lifetime benefits were removed by tier remapping and AppSumo users were left out of a new Image to Image feature, outweighing the single positive review.

exhibits.quote: FlexClip’s recent remapping of lifetime tiers has resulted in the removal and reduction of benefits that were part of my original purchase.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports lifetime benefits were removed by remapping, contradicting grandfathering into new features and limits.

exhibits.quote: For example, with the Image to Image feature, AppSumo users were left out.
exhibits.argument: AppSumo users were excluded from a new feature, contradicting the promise that previous customers are grandfathered into new features.

exhibits.quote: It's nice of them to include them in our lifetime deal and not move them over into a separate AI tool and sell it as an add-on.
exhibits.argument: The quote confirms new AI tools were included in the lifetime deal rather than sold separately.

trials.claim: Support promises help for bugs via support email
trials.claimQuote: If you encounter any bugs or issues while using FlexClip, please contact the support team at support@flexclip.com with detailed information about the problem.
trials.reasoning: Two buyers report receiving no support or no response after contacting the vendor, contradicting the promise of help via support.

exhibits.quote: No support and no hint how to solve the problem.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports receiving no support when export failed, undermining the promise of help via support email.

exhibits.quote: I tried to contact them but never received any response.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports contacting the vendor received no response, contradicting the support-help promise.

trials.claim: Seller promises professional video creation with AI tools, 4M+ stock assets and templates
trials.claimQuote: Create, edit, and share professional videos with AI-powered tools, 4M+ stock assets, and ready-made templates
trials.reasoning: The vendor and a 5-star review confirm video creation with templates, editing tools, smart AI and stock footage; the negative reviews are subjective quality complaints that do not show the tools are absent.

exhibits.quote: However, the AI tools feel a bit unhelpful right now.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports AI tools are unhelpful, undermining the promise of professional creation with AI tools.

exhibits.quote: The text-to-speech feature made words unrecognizable, and some voices sounded downright strange.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports core AI audio output is unrecognizable and strange, contradicting professional-quality AI creation.

exhibits.quote: Create videos faster with rich templates, easy editing tools, and smart AI.
exhibits.argument: The vendor statement confirms fast video creation with templates, editing tools and smart AI.

exhibits.quote: Feed it a script, blog link, PDF, or PowerPoint, and it instantly builds a full video with matching stock footage, transitions, voiceover, and captions.
exhibits.argument: The review confirms AI-powered professional video creation using stock footage and automation.

trials.claim: FlexClip is an easy-to-use editor available for Windows, Mac and Linux
trials.claimQuote: FlexClip is an easy-to-use video editor available for Windows, Mac, and Linux.
trials.reasoning: Buyers report the editor only works on a computer with Chrome and does not work on Safari, materially limiting the claimed broad Windows, Mac and Linux availability despite reviews calling it easy to use.

exhibits.quote: It only works on a computer and with the Chrome browser.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports the editor is limited to computer Chrome, contradicting availability for Windows, Mac and Linux and easy use.

exhibits.quote: Tried on Safari, but realized that Text-To-Video is not working in any form
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports the tool does not work on Safari, undermining broad availability and easy-to-use claims.

exhibits.quote: FlexClip is a powerful yet easy-to-use online video editing tool.
exhibits.argument: The vendor description confirms FlexClip is an easy-to-use online video editing tool.

exhibits.quote: Great Software and very easy to use the software.
exhibits.argument: The buyer review confirms the editor is very easy to use.

trials.claim: Offers over 4,000 templates for various purposes
trials.claimQuote: It offers over 4,000 templates for various purposes, including education, business, marketing, festivals, special events, and social media platforms.
trials.reasoning: Reviews confirm a large number of ready-made templates for purposes including promotional videos, events, intros, slideshows and product showcases, with no contrary exhibit.

exhibits.quote: The large number of templates have expanded my ability to quickly edit short promotional videos for my podcast and other events.
exhibits.argument: The review confirms a large number of templates usable for promotional videos, podcasts and events.

exhibits.quote: it includes ready-made video templates (intros, slideshows, product showcases, etc.) that are easy to edit
exhibits.argument: The review confirms ready-made templates for various purposes like intros, slideshows and showcases.
